name: same-binary-aa
methodology: Same preserved saturated compiler binary on both sides; nine alternating pairs TypeORM/tRPC and five VS Code/Sentry, one warmup each. Default runtime/checker/GC settings, identical GNU time wrappers and libraries, fresh compiler process each invocation. All samples retained. This estimates within-session variability, not candidate speed. No builds, tests or profiles during measurement. A separate confirmation policy will be frozen after this calibration and before examining indexed-candidate timing. Native target is not measured here.
